title: First Flight at Kitty Hawk
description:
On December 17, 1903, the **Wright Brothers** achieved the first controlled, sustained flight of a powered, heavier-than-air aircraft near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.

Orville Wright piloted the first flight, which lasted 12 seconds and covered 120 feet. By the end of the day, they had made four flights, with the longest lasting 59 seconds and covering 852 feet.

This achievement marked the beginning of the aviation age and revolutionized transportation and warfare.
